parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is purely that they are zero-field type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or serve the same domain concept. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, application lifecycle), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct player subsystems), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, network request signalling) each encode unrelated domain events whose coincidental structural shape — an empty type alias — is the entire basis for the cluster match. Merging or extracting these into a shared type would conflate unrelated message semantics and couple three independent packages (Core, Playback, MusicShareKit) without any real deduplication benefit. The `shared_field_count: 1` with `differing_slots: null` and `jaccard: null` further confirms the match is on shape alone, not on shared content.
